guides.treatment_action:
Recommended treatment actions:  
- Implement and enforce secure remote access protocols (e.g., TLS 1.2 or higher, multi-factor authentication) for all remote connections to SRV-03 and SRV-04  
- Apply patches and updates to address the identified vulnerabilities (CVE-2017-0144, CVE-2021-44228, CVE-2021-31166) on SRV-03 and SRV-04  
- Restrict remote management access (e.g., WinRM) to trusted networks and use firewall rules to limit exposure  
- Develop and enforce a remote working policy that includes secure configuration and usage guidelines for remote access technologies
guides.evidence_name: The host SRV-03 under control 6.7 demonstrates secure remote access protocols...
guides.evidence_description: The host SRV-03 under control 6.7 demonstrates secure remote access protocols (TLS 1.2, MFA) and applied patches for CVE-2017-0144, ensuring mitigation of remote code execution risks through structured remote working policies.
